messages:
tyler: Hey team — node gpu-34 on eu-west-2 is flapping with repeated Xid 13s during long seq workloads. Noticed 6 drains in the last 48h. Can we confirm RMA path and whether we have a local spare for that rack?

maria: I saw the logs, looks like ECC spikes just before the Xids. Not a thermal issue. Ran `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC` and counters jump.

jamie: @tyler can you paste the serial? I'll check vendor ticket backlog.

tyler: Serial is GPC-9Z4F-3342. Node id infra-eu-node-13.

lisa: Tagging @rma-bot to open a vendor ticket. We should pre-authorize depot swap because cluster is close to capacity this week. :warning:

rma-bot: rma-bot: Created ticket RMA-8921 against vendor "ExaCompute". ETA for depot pickup currently 5-7 business days. Reservation: spare-pool-eu (pending approval).

maria: If pickup is 5-7 days we need a hot-swap plan. Do we have a handcarry or crossdock option? Courier rates spike this quarter though.

jamie: Depot-EU says they can do a priority handcarry to the LHR crossdock if we provide manifest and pre-paid label. @depot-eu any customs hold risk?

depot-eu: depot-eu: No customs expected within EU if we use the standard commercial invoice. We need a manifest with serial, model, and failure code. Send as CSV or inline list.

tyler: Adding the manifest below (use for label creation):
```
serial,model,part,fail_code
GPC-9Z4F-3342,RTX-80XT,PN-88902,XID13_ECC
GPC-0A1B-7710,RTX-80XT,PN-88902,ECC_CORR_HIGH
```

lisa: @courier-ops please book a same-day handcarry from LHR to our on-prem staging on Tuesday. Budget cap $1200 — we can exception.

courier-ops: courier-ops: Noted. Need pickup window and contact. Can you confirm pickup at depot B, 09:00-11:00? Also need the commercial invoice PDF.

tyler: Pickup window confirmed. I'll upload invoice to the ticket. Also we should mark node as DO_NOT_ALLOC until replacement is physically installed. `kubectl label node infra-eu-node-13 temporary=true`

maria: I'll update the spare assignment logic to avoid scheduling long jobs on that shard. Recommending to route high-seq tests to dedicated nodes to reduce failure recurrence.

jamie: Vendor asked if we want serial swap or full unit swap. Full unit swap preferred for hot-swap but vendor charges extra. Thoughts?

lisa: Full unit swap — we can't risk another partial failure during heavy load this week. Approve extra cost. :+1:

rma-bot: rma-bot: Vendor has accepted full chassis swap. New ticket RMA-8921-A created. Return label pending.

tyler: After arrival I'll run diagnostic checklist: `stress-ng` 2h, ECC counters baseline, `nvidia-healthmon` for 24h, then reintroduce to pool if clean.

maria: One more ask — capture the failure trace from our tracing infra and attach to ticket. Helps vendor reproduce.

tyler: Will do. Attaching traces and kube events to RMA ticket now.

jamie: Thanks. I'll monitor the vendor ETA and post updates here. If courier stalls we escalate to regional ops.

lisa: Noted. If we end up doing a local spare swap, repo the replaced card to central bin 4 and update inventory sheet `spare-inventory-eu.csv`.

tyler: Quick note: flagged two other nodes with similar ECC trends (gpu-67, gpu-88) — opening separate threads to avoid mixing tickets.

maria: Perfect. Closing loop here once RMA done. :white_check_mark:
